entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Othon Frédéric Jean-Baptiste, Comte de Clarac was a French artist, scholar and archaeologist. He published a catalogue of the Musée du Louvre, and a Manuel de l'Histoire de l'art and also that which is considered his best work: the Musée de sculpture antique et moderne, 1826–1852, completed after his death.
